name: Novotel Living Saigon South
short_description: A 4-star apart-hotel in Phu My Hung, Ho Chi Minh City, with 175 fully furnished studios and apartments steps from the Saigon Exhibition and Convention Center, holding a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (403 reviews).
ai_summary: Novotel Living Saigon South is a 4-star apart-hotel in Ho Chi Minh City's walkable Phu My Hung urban area, just steps from the Saigon Exhibition and Convention Center (SECC). It offers 175 spacious, fully furnished studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments with work desks and Wi-Fi, aimed at both short stays and longer-term living. On-site dining is handled by Food Exchange Saigon South, a 70-seat restaurant serving Asian and international cuisine, and the property has a modern meeting room for up to 25 guests. The hotel holds a 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 403 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
